deps.auto_setup_intro: Auto-setup will create {dir} and install {pkgs} there, then restart proxyprof. No sudo, no system-package changes.
deps.download_failed_hint: Check your network connection and try again.
deps.venv_hint: Install the venv module first: sudo apt install python3-venv
input.no_input: no proxy input. Pipe a list via stdin (e.g. `proxine http -s | proxyprof http`) or use `-f FILE`.
input.no_valid_pairs: no valid IP:PORT pairs in input.
input.access_url_invalid: --access-test URL '{url}' must start with http:// or https://
input.judge_must_be_http: --judge must start with http:// or https://
cli.description: Profile a list of proxies: connectivity, anonymity level (elite / anonymous / transparent), and optional access test. Designed to chain after `proxine`.
cli.example.pipe: Pipe proxine output, keep only elite (with CONNECT tunnel test)
cli.example.file_in: File in, elite+anon, save to file
cli.example.access_test: Add 3 random CF gatekeepers to the filter
cli.example.no_tunnel: Skip CONNECT test (faster, accepts non-tunnel proxies)
cli.example.cf_judge: Use your CF-protected judge (adds country info + visit logs)
cli.group.scan_desc: Network behaviour: concurrency, timeouts, and which probes are sent per proxy. Probes cost extra requests; flags here affect duration.
cli.group.filter_desc: Post-scan filters: which good proxies make it into the final list. No extra network cost; they just gate the output.
cli.group.output_desc: Where the filtered proxy list goes; how loud stderr is.
cli.help.protocol: Proxy protocol of every entry in the input list.
cli.help.file: Proxy list file (default: stdin if piped). Use '-' for stdin.
cli.help.judge: Custom judge URL (azenv.php-compatible). The identity header X-Proxyprof-Proxy is sent only to judges hosted on the hardcoded trusted domains: {domains}.
cli.help.access_test: Filter proxies by access through gatekeeper URLs. Without value: pick {count} random sites from the built-in Cloudflare list (every CF-protected site's /cdn-cgi/trace endpoint). With value: comma-separated URLs; proxy must reach ALL of them. Disabled by default.
cli.help.no_access_test: Skip access-test entirely. Overrides --access-test. Faster scan; output includes proxies that pass the judge regardless of real-world site access.
cli.help.tunnel_test: Verify HTTPS CONNECT tunneling via {url}. For http/https proxies probes CONNECT support; for SOCKS proxies (which always tunnel) is used to trigger the MITM probe. Enabled by default; use --no-tunnel-test to skip the HTTPS probe entirely (also disables MITM detection).
cli.help.mitm_test: Detect proxies that intercept TLS (MITM). The HTTPS probe runs with strict cert verification — proxies whose response fails cert validation but successfully opened the CONNECT tunnel are flagged as MITM-suspected and excluded from output. Requires --tunnel-test (the same probe yields both signals); --no-tunnel-test implicitly disables this too.
cli.help.reputation: SQLite reputation DB path. Tracks each proxy's history across runs so HOT (recently-good) proxies are tested first and COLD (repeatedly-failed) proxies enter exponential probation (skipped 2^k runs after k consecutive failures, capped). Default: {default}
cli.help.no_reputation: Disable the reputation store entirely. Scanning becomes fully stateless — no proxy is prioritised from the list.
cli.help.dead_threshold: Consecutive fail count after which a proxy enters COLD bucket and starts exponential probation (default: {default}).
cli.help.probation_max_skip: Maximum skip factor for COLD probation (default: {default}). At max, a dead proxy is re-tested every N runs — never fully forgotten.
cli.help.cold_timeout: Per-proxy timeout used ONLY for COLD bucket probes (default: {default}). Shorter than --timeout because most cold proxies will time out anyway; saves wall-clock time.
cli.help.level: Maximum anonymity level kept (1=elite only, 2=elite+anon, 3=all). Default: {default}.
cli.help.country: Keep only proxies from these ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. --country TR or --country TR,US,DE). Requires a CF-aware judge that returns PROXY_COUNTRY; public azenv judges don't supply country, so this filter drops all proxies in that case.
cli.help.exclude_distorting: Drop distorting proxies (anonymous proxies that inject a FAKE public IP into X-Forwarded-For). Off by default — distorting proxies count as Level 2 and pass --level filter normally.
cli.help.output: Write good proxies to FILE; stdout stays empty.
cli.help.verbose: Deprecated, no-op (the live table is now the default).
cli.help.silent: Only print the proxy list to stdout; suppress all stderr.
cli.help.lang: UI language code. Supported: {supported}. Default: system locale, falling back to '{default}'. Also honoured: PROXYPROF_LANG env var.
misc.unsupported_lang: unsupported language '{lang}'. Available: {supported}. Falling back to '{fallback}'.
